previous_statement: Still under that extra hypothesis, substitute the inverse identity into the contour definition theta(U)=(2 pi i)^{-1} integral_Gamma theta(lambda)(lambda 1-U)^{-1} d lambda. Linearity of iota_n gives theta(iota_n(T))=iota_n(theta(T)). This proves only the conditional statement; the registered def-compressed-corner supplies no premise identifying its theta with this construction, so node 1.4 and hence the root remain unsupported without an additional allowed definition or external theorem.
new_statement: Still under the extra hypothesis of node 1.3, node 1.3.2.1 proves that, for each fixed n, the entrywise amplification iota_n:B(A)->B(M_n(A)) is bounded linear (indeed ||iota_n||<=n^2). Therefore iota_n commutes with the Banach-valued contour integral. Substituting the inverse identity from node 1.3.1 into theta(U)=(2 pi i)^{-1} integral_Gamma theta(lambda)(lambda 1-U)^{-1} d lambda yields theta(iota_n(T))=iota_n(theta(T)). This proves only the conditional statement; def-compressed-corner supplies no premise identifying its theta with this construction, so node 1.4 and hence the root remain unsupported without an additional allowed definition or external theorem.
